verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions to identity events are a fair question for an identity and admin platform like Google Workspace, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only pull-style Reports API audit reports, alert viewing, and automatic user provisioning to third-party apps. None of these documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks firing on user lifecycle or auth events.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
